patch_description: Remove the global rx_shared layer that degraded performance and reintroduce the CRX sublayer with a dedicated parameter "ent_crx" instead of sharing "ent_nn". This decoupling allows narrow-angle CRX rotations to express entanglement patterns independently, potentially improving the worst_group_margin which is the main bottleneck. The prior CRX program scored 0.67 with this approach; this variant tests whether parameter decoupling can further improve robustness on hard samples while keeping parameter count manageable (8 distinct params vs current 8, but with better expressivity).
